title: ARCH↔HW-001: Platform Constraints + Board Feasibility Feedback
description: Architect supplies platform-selection rationale, per-node resource/power budgets, sensor-bus topology, and debug/security-element requirements; Hardware returns board feasibility confirmation, electrical constraints, sensor specifications, and bring-up findings/errata. Grounded in EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_ARCHITECT_SKILL §6.2.

per_node_budgets.description: Per-node resource and power budgets. Every quantity carries an explicit unit (no TBD).

energy_budget_mwh_per_day.description: Daily energy budget in mWh (solar-constrained node).

security_element_required.description: Whether a secure element / root-of-trust device is required (see HW↔SEC-001).

debug_port_lockdown_required.description: Whether debug-port lockdown is mandated (security baseline).

electrical_constraints.description: Electrical constraints feeding back into the budget.

adr_ref.description: Required when verdict = INFEASIBLE (platform change is a STRATEGIC ADR).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Platform-selection trade study crosses ≥2 role boundaries and is ARB-governed; a platform change is a STRATEGIC ADR (Tier-1). Routine schematic/errata triage is Tier-3.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (platform-selection trade study; schematic review; board bring-up; errata triage)
confirm_conditions: platform_constraints carries mcu_family and per_node_budgets with explicit units (flash KB, SRAM KB, power mW)
feasibility_verdict = FEASIBLE, or FEASIBLE_WITH_CONSTRAINTS with electrical_constraints enumerated
every sensor_spec carries sampling_rate_hz and resolution_bits
CRITICAL/HIGH errata carry a workaround or an ADR reference
reject_conditions: any per_node budget expressed without a unit or as TBD (violates §3.10)
feasibility_verdict = INFEASIBLE without an adr_ref (silent deviation forbidden)
platform changed outside the approved stack without a STRATEGIC ADR
counter_conditions: budget exceedance within unquantified tolerance — request the Architect file/confirm the budget-trade ADR (tolerance bands not yet ratified, CLAUDE.md §6.5)
errata severity unclear — request reproduction conditions before sign-off
